description: Land Acquisition - Kumbukgahamulla, Udubaddawa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire specific parcels of land (Kumbukgahamulla Estate and Meegahakumbura) for public purposes. It provides detailed descriptions of the properties, including their names, lot numbers, extents, and current use. The notice also outlines the process for claimants to seek compensation. This content falls squarely within the "Land Gazettes" category (Type 4) as it deals exclusively with land acquisition, a core land and property-related matter.
